description.text:
This is a private Gamescope protocol. Regular Wayland clients must not use
it.

args.name: description
args.summary: human-readable description as to what the action is for, used for debugging purposes.

args.name: sequence
args.summary: global sequence no of actions that have been trigged

args.name: time_lo
args.summary: lower bits of 64-bit timestamp in nanos (CLOCK_MONOTONIC)

args.name: time_hi
args.summary: upper bits of 64-bit timestamp in nanos (CLOCK_MONOTONIC)

description.text: Flags that control how the action is armed.

entries.name: one_shot
entries.summary: disarm this action immediately after trigger. unrelated to niko

entries.name: no_block
entries.summary: don't block the result of this shortcut being seen by the app and keep processing hotkeys

description.text: Flags that say how the action was triggered.

entries.name: keyboard
entries.summary: action was triggered by keyboard trigger
